findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe integer operations in parser
 * @description Large integer operations without bounds checking could overflow
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-integer-operations
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-190
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("int").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("float").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("int").getACall()
  ) and
  // Check if conversion is done without try-except or bounds checking nearby
  not exists(Try try | 
    try.getBody().contains(call.asExpr())
  )
select call, "Unsafe type conversion without error handling may cause unexpected behavior"
findings.hypothesis: Integer overflow or unsafe type conversions in parsing operations that could lead to unexpected behavior

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Information disclosure in exception messages
 * @description Exception messages that include sensitive data can leak information
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity recommendation
 * @id py/information-disclosure-exception
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-209
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("Exception").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("ValueError").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("RuntimeError").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("TypeError").getACall()
  ) and
  exists(call.getArg(0))
select call, "Exception raised with custom message that might disclose information"
findings.hypothesis: Information disclosure through verbose error messages that might expose internal state or paths

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unbounded recursion depth vulnerability
 * @description Recursive functions without depth limits can cause stack overflow with nested input
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unbounded-recursion-depth
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-674
 */

import python

from Function func, FunctionExpr fe
where
  // Find recursive function calls
  exists(Call call |
    call.getScope() = func and
    call.getFunc().(Name).getId() = func.getName()
  ) and
  // Check if there's no depth parameter or counter
  not exists(Parameter p | 
    p = func.getAnArg() and
    (p.getName().matches("%depth%") or p.getName().matches("%limit%") or p.getName().matches("%level%"))
  )
select func, "Recursive function '" + func.getName() + "' without depth limit could cause stack overflow with deeply nested input"
findings.hypothesis: Recursive parsing functions without depth limits could be exploited with deeply nested TOML structures to cause stack overflow DoS

message.text: Recursive function 'set' without depth limit could cause stack overflow with deeply nested input
